title: Real snapshot production for coordinator disk checkpoints
description:
BLOCKER for run disk-durability including the ending boundary (dwm-p2r.7 Task 6 disk piece).

Finding 2026-08-03 during .7 Task 6 planning: the real SaveManagerCheckpointPort.prepare requires a full snapshot bundle (CHECKPOINT_INPUT_KEYS): snapshot_input WITH a lifecycle object (hence ending_plan/gameplay), plus dialogic_checkpoint, route_id, active_app_id, audio_context, content_version. But GameStateDayResolutionPort.prepare_completion emits a STUB snapshot_input = {run_id, day} only (class header: real production arrives with the Plan04 integration tasks). The real checkpoint port rejects the stub with invalid_checkpoint_inputs. Coordinator tests pass only because they use FakeCheckpointPort, which does not validate input shape.

Consequence: NO path persists a real ENDING or any snapshot to disk today. Direct scene path records no stable checkpoint (autosave returns no_stable_checkpoint, ignored); coordinator path cannot feed the real checkpoint port.

Work: make GameStateDayResolutionPort produce the full CHECKPOINT_INPUT_KEYS bundle from live GameState capture (GameState has prepare_new_run_snapshot_input for NEW runs; needs a live-run equivalent), then verify coordinator + real SaveManagerCheckpointPort + SaveManager write a real autosave that round-trips.

Dependency: dialogic_checkpoint is sourced from Dialogic which is a .8 deliverable. So this is a .8-era foundation affecting ALL day-resolution checkpoints, not just endings. Do not fold into an ending ticket.

Acceptance: driving the real coordinator days 1-7 with the real checkpoint port writes a disk autosave whose snapshot round-trips through restore; for day 7 the ending_plan survives and the restored run re-walks to COMPLETED. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-phase-2r-07-ending-boundary-disk-durability-design.md Blocked section.
acceptance_criteria: Driving the real coordinator through Days 1-7 with the real checkpoint port writes valid disk autosaves; the Day-7 autosave restores through configured production participants to day 7 in ENDING with the exact ending_plan, and the restored run re-walks idempotently to COMPLETED with Gallery recorded. Lifecycle/schema validators agree on the exact stage-aware post-increment source-day rule, saved checkpoints contain the completed causal stage, sequential day plans can advance, and production provider wiring is exercised.
notes: Audit 2026-08-10: focused current-worktree tests are GREEN, but acceptance is not yet proven and this issue must remain open/uncommitted. The integration only drives Day 1; its restore assertion accepts {ok:false}, configures no restore participants, commits no restore, and never re-walks a Day-7 ending to COMPLETED. RunSnapshotSchema permits a post-increment source_day/day gap while RunLifecycle still rejects it; the validator rule must be unified and stage-aware. The written checkpoint is also captured before stage completion, and completed day plans currently cannot be replaced for sequential Days 2-7. Add RED coverage for these gaps, actual Days 1-7 + Day-7 ending disk restore, production provider wiring, and the exact restored plan before commit/close.
close_reason: Real snapshot production lands: full CHECKPOINT_INPUT_KEYS bundle accepted by the real SaveManagerCheckpointPort, checkpoints carry post-completion lifecycle, Days 1-7 walk and Day-7 crash restore proven on disk.

title: Choose narrative localization adapter after representative files exist
description:
## Rationale

Only English Dialogic timelines physically exist, while the user will supply already-localized narrative files later. Choosing an adapter before one representative source/translation set exists would assume an unknown physical format and could damage stable IDs, branches, or Dialogic round trips. Affected requirement: req.locale.narrative_deferred. This decision blocks translated narrative import only; it does not block Phase 2R UI localization or English narrative validation.

## Alternatives Considered

- Godot TranslationServer resources: rejected because the approved architecture uses the user's own localized files and custom JSON for UI localization.
- Preselect a duplicated-Dialogic-timeline adapter now: rejected until physical translated files prove their structure and stable-ID behavior.
- Test at least two adapters against representative files, then record the evidence-backed choice: selected decision process.

## Decision Trigger

Reopen active work when one representative English source and corresponding external localized files are present. Inspect their formats, stable IDs, branches, and round-trip requirements before proposing the adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Representative source and translated files are present; at least two viable adapters are tested against them; the chosen adapter preserves stable IDs, branches, and Dialogic structure without inventing prose; the decision packet records evidence and closes this issue.
notes: 2026-09-12: keep future narrative-translation adapter decision deferred until representative authored translated DTL files exist, consistent with owner dialogue deferral. Primary-language UI work is separate. docs/agent/2026-09-12-backlog-reconciliation.md

title: Dating rounds cannot begin during the deferred-pair presentation (stage-level route, no substage)
description: FOUND BY the dwm-p2r.23 fresh-context review, 2026-08-21, verified in source at 32416d7f4. The dwm-p2r.23 fix makes _resolve_dating_evidence resolve the ONE active surviving_date SUBSTAGE, which covers ordinary date presentations - but the deferred PAIR presentation is a TOP-LEVEL STAGE (twofriends_if_deferred, route "dating", a real paused presentation via _deferred_pair_site), during which the one active record is the stage itself, not any surviving_date: substage. A dating-context Minesweeper round attempted during the deferred-pair presentation therefore still fails DATING_ROUTE_NOT_ACTIVE - the same unbeginnable-round bug dwm-p2r.23 fixed, one door over. WHETHER IT MATTERS depends on design intent: if the deferred pair presentation can host boards (its timeline id is dating.twofriends...pre_challenge, which suggests it can), the resolver needs a stage-level branch deriving evidence from the deferred pair entry (the committed group entry Hospital superseded, participants priscilla+lavinia); if pair presentations never host boards, that must be recorded deliberately. ACCEPTANCE: decide with the design authority; if boards are hosted, RED first over the real port with a deferred-pair pause (the matrix suite's group-seed machinery reaches it); either way the resolver's docstring states which presentations can begin rounds.
close_reason: Closed

comments.author: Siuuuers
comments.text:
DESIGN DIRECTION 2026-08-21, decided at the maintainer's request during the review-and-close pass - and the game's own content decides it, no taste required: data/manifests/timelines.json registers pre_challenge AND post_challenge timelines for EVERY dating presentation kind, including both deferred-pair windows (dating.twofriends.priscilla_lavinia.day2.pre_challenge/.post_challenge and the day6 pair), and the production port already selects the pair pre_challenge timeline (GameStateDayResolutionPort.gd:1083). "Challenge" is this game's word for the Minesweeper board between those two timelines. VERDICT: the deferred-pair presentation HOSTS A BOARD by design, so this bead is a real bug, not a recorded limit.

THE FIX SHAPE, following dwm-p2r.23's pattern one level up: _resolve_dating_evidence gains a stage-level branch - when the ACTIVE record is the twofriends_if_deferred STAGE (no substage), the evidence derives from the deferred pair entry the plan already carries (the committed group entry Hospital superseded: entry_id from contacts.group_action.deferred_twofriends' matched committed entry exactly as _deferred_pair_site derives it, friend_ids = the committed entry's participants [priscilla, lavinia], route_transaction_id = the pair stage's own transaction). The .23 laws carry over verbatim: trusted values from the plan, never the request; the superseded-date filter is IRRELEVANT here by construction (the pair exists BECAUSE Hospital superseded the group entry - it is the presentation of a superseded entry, which is why the filter must scope to the substage branch only, worth a docstring sentence so nobody "fixes" that). RED first over the real port at the pair pause - the matrix suite's group-seed walk (_await_stage_presentation(PAIR_STAGE)) already reaches it, so the substrate exists. The resolver docstring then states the complete law: rounds begin during a surviving-date SUBSTAGE pause or the deferred-pair STAGE pause, and nowhere else.

Implementable under the standing Phase-2R runtime authority with the full ritual (RED, fresh-context review, mutations, gates). Sequenced behind dwm-p2r.15 (the P0 evidence seal) in the current queue.

comments.author: Siuuuers
comments.text:
FIXED at commit b1fc0ed3c002873c2b66bd76cf136b0d5d114b5e, a direct child of 69cf694e0 (the dwm-pm4 roster unification), containing exactly scripts/application/minesweeper/GameStateMinesweeperPort.gd, tests/integration/test_committed_schedule_presentation_matrix.gd, and the two handoff artifacts that actually changed (minesweeper_contract.json - the port sha line - and the seven-record phase3_contracts.commands.jsonl). desktop_contract.json regenerated BYTE-IDENTICAL because none of its bound sources moved, exactly as the review predicted, so it is honestly absent from the commit. Not pushed. Implemented per the bead's recorded design direction (pair presentations host boards - the timeline manifest registers pre_challenge/post_challenge for the twofriends kind), reviewed BEFORE production code by the workstream's TWELFTH fresh-context review.

THE COLD REVIEW, its twelfth catch in twelve cycles, found the plan's M2 killer was built on a FALSE PREMISE: the .28 pair-settle pin never completes the pair stage (presentation_stage_receipt is a pure envelope producer; only RunLifecycle.complete_active_stage flips a stage), so the sketched killer would have gone red against CORRECT code while killing nothing. It also corrected two equivalence claims: the plan's DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE was fiction (_deferred_pair_entry_id already reads the durable superseded set + committed entries at GameStateDayResolutionPort.gd:898-917, so the new helper is equivalence BY CONSTRUCTION), and a mixed ordinary+group seed cannot kill the kind-filter mutant (ordinary entries are never superseded - HospitalRules filters to DATE_KINDS before building misses). Its Q1 answer strengthened the design: exactly one committed group entry per day is guaranteed by disjoint manifest allowed_days + action_not_repeatable + superseded_solo_date, with the uniqueness recorded as a MANIFEST invariant, and the only zero-match windows (tampered restored bytes, the synchronous empty-site transient) are closed by amendment 2's fail-closed door. All seven amendments adopted.

THE FIX: _resolve_dating_evidence's stage loop now handles the ACTIVE twofriends_if_deferred TOP-LEVEL STAGE before the substage descent, minting pair evidence via the new plan-pure _superseded_group_evidence: scan the frozen committed entries for the action_kind==group entry in the durable superseded set (first match, byte-identical with the day-resolution port's own law), friends via the existing _committed_participants (one law), route transaction = the pair stage's own, FAIL CLOSED when nothing matches. The substage branch and its superseded-date refusal are untouched - the pair IS the presentation of a superseded entry, stated in the resolver docstring.

RED, observed first (p2r30-red.log): 21 tests, 20 passing, 1829/1830, red on EXACTLY the new test's ok assert with the live bug verbatim (DATING_ROUTE_NOT_ACTIVE, no active route substage, at the genuine pair pause). GREEN first try (p2r30-green.log): 21/21, 1833. The two review-designed pins then landed GREEN ON ARRIVAL (p2r30-green2.log): 23/23, 1889 - the completed-stage refusal pin (the amended M2 killer: settle through the seam, complete_active_stage with the settle receipt, prepare_begin must refuse) and the live-contacts-scramble pin (.23's trusted-source law one level up: participant_ids scrambled to an impostor, evidence still names the frozen pair).

MUTATIONS, five run, each applied to the pristine fixed bytes, observed, reverted:
M1 stage branch reverted: 21/23 - the .30 test AND the scramble pin red with the live bug verbatim; the completed-stage pin rightly green (refusal is correct there under the mutant too).
M2 stage-state check dropped: 22/23, red EXACTLY the completed-stage pin - the mutant minted a full round transaction against a FINISHED presentation (ok:true in the failure bytes). Killed ONLY by the review's replacement killer; the plan's original sketch would have been red-against-correct-code.

comments.text:
FACTS RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-21 at c3c83aabc during the overnight queue run; the bead's premises have drifted and the work is deliberately NOT done on them.

1. There are now THREE copies, not two: scripts/data/DataCatalog.gd:16, scripts/domain/contact/ContactInvitationState.gd:17, and autoload/GameState.gd:25 - all ["priscilla", "lavinia", "sylvia"]. The GameState copy has its own internal consumers (:235, :889, :971, :1114 and more).
2. The bead's canonical-choice rationale is stale: ScheduleRules does NOT validate friend_ids against DataCatalog - its header says "This module never reads DataCatalog" (the registry is injected), and a repo-wide grep finds NO consumer of DataCatalog.FRIEND_IDS outside DataCatalog itself. Every copy is internally consumed only; nothing detects drift between any pair.
3. Mechanics verified for whenever the direction is chosen: no preload cycle exists in either direction (DataCatalog preloads shop/schedule registries and StrictJson, none of which reach ContactInvitationState); ContactInvitationState.FRIEND_IDS has NO external consumers, so its copy can be re-pointed without touching callers; _has_exact_keys takes an untyped Array so the Array[String]-vs-Array typing difference is not load-bearing at the call sites checked.
4. The DIRECTION is now a design decision, not a dedup: DataCatalog's own philosophy ("registries OWN their facts; this catalog stores none of them and keeps only derived presentation") argues the roster's owner should be a DOMAIN module with data and autoload aliasing it - the OPPOSITE of the bead's original instruction - and any choice now touches the GameState autoload. That choice belongs to the maintainer; an overnight autonomous run does not make it on stale premises.

Left OPEN with acceptance unchanged. When direction is chosen, the shape is small: one canonical declaration, two aliases via path-preload (per DECISION 9.18's headless class-cache rule), plus a drift pin asserting the aliases are the canonical object.

comments.text: DESIGN DIRECTION 2026-08-21, chosen by the maintainer via direct question during the review-and-close pass: ContactInvitationState OWNS the canonical FRIEND_IDS roster.
